about: The texting provider's Advanced Opt-Out settings (CON-030, CON-009, D-492, D-493). The fake Twilio matches inbound keywords and sends its reply from this file; the app's own word lists must equal it (T029).

reply.en: Laftly: You're unsubscribed. You won't get more texts or automated calls from Laftly at this number. To use Laftly again, text START.
reply.es: Laftly: Se canceló su suscripción. No recibirá más textos ni llamadas automáticas de Laftly en este número. Para volver a usar Laftly, envíe START.

reply.en: Laftly: You can text us again. Send your request to start. Msg & data rates may apply. Reply HELP for help, STOP to opt out.
